mapper.insert: INSERT INTO linked_account (member_id, bank_code, account_number, account_number_hash, is_primary) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{bankCode}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountNumberHash}, #{isPrimary})
mapper.select: SELECT la.*, bm.bank_name FROM linked_account la JOIN bank_master bm ON bm.bank_code = la.bank_code WHERE la.member_id = #{memberId} AND la.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT la.*, bm.bank_name FROM linked_account la JOIN bank_master bm ON bm.bank_code = la.bank_code WHERE la.account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE linked_account SET status = #{status}, is_primary = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'INACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE is_primary END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
UPDATE linked_account SET is_primary = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE linked_account SET is_primary = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
